title: iPhone driver's licenses are coming to another state
description: iPhone and Apple Watch users in Oklahoma will soon be able to add their driver's licenses and IDs to the Apple Wallet app. Apple is in fact already working on supporting this feature in its backend systems, according to a new report. Oklahoma passed a House bill in March that allows Service Oklahoma to issue mobile or digital versions of stated ID cards and driver’s licenses, and this is a consequence of that bill. These digital IDs and driver’s licenses are not intended to replace the physical versions, so people in Oklahoma will still need to have the latter. The digital versions...

title: Spotify gets a Running Mode
description: Spotify has now added a new Running Mode to its iOS app for Premium subscribers in the US, Canada, the UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, and Sweden. If you are in one of the supported countries and have an iPhone, you should be able to find the Running Mode in the Fitness Hub already. Inside the Running Mode you will find 25 curated running playlists, which you can customize by workout type, duration, beats per minute, and what type of music you're in the mood for. Once you press play, Spotify will guide your run with music tailored to your workout. The playlist "seamlessly moves...

title: DJI Osmo Pocket 4P goes global
description: Following its announcement last month, DJI has now expanded the Osmo Pocket 4P’s availability outside of China. The flagship vlogging camera is now available across Europe, Canada and Australia but notably absent from the US due to the ongoing FCC ban on foreign-made camera and drone equipment. With the Pocket 4P, DJI is bringing a dual-lens setup. There’s an all-new 1-inch main sensor with LOFIC technology, an f/2.0 aperture, and an equivalent focal length of 20mm. It is capable of recording up to 4K 240FPS video and shoots 37MP still images. DJI Osmo Pocket 4P The...

title: Redmi K100 Pro leaks with vibrant red color
description: The Redmi K100 Pro continues to leak ahead of its launch. A new poster making rounds on Weibo gives us our best look at the device yet. The overall design looks similar to the Redmi K90 Pro Max with a triple camera setup inside an island configuration. We can also spot what appears to be a subwoofer, which could again feature Bose branding and sound tuning. The more interesting bit is the color choice. The dark red is quite similar to the rumored Cherry-red color that’s expected to be the hero hue for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Funnily enough, Xiaomi will beat Apple to the punch...

title: Here's when Honor is officially introducing MagicOS 11 based on Android 17
description: Last week, Honor opened its early access program for the upcoming MagicOS 11 based on Android 17 for the Magic V6, and today the brand has officially announced the new software's unveiling date. Honor is holding a "Pioneer Event" in China on August 6, which is when it will officially showcase MagicOS 11 and all of its new features. As you can see, a glass-like UI is coming, because of course it is - Apple's influence over Chinese Android makers is undeniable. title: Full specs for the global Redmi Note 17 devices are out alongside leaked images
description: A few days ago we shared purported European pricing for the upcoming global Redmi Note 17 lineup, and today the same source is back with their full specs and the leaked images you can see below. The Redmi Note 17 will have a 6.99-inch 1080x2396 AMOLED screen with 120Hz refresh rate, 1,800-nit peak brightness, and Gorilla Glass 7i on top, a 50MP main camera with f/1.8 aperture, a 16MP selfie shooter, and a 7,700 mAh battery with support for 45W fast wired charging. title: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro teased by online retailer
description: Samsung introduced the Galaxy F70e in February, with the F70 Pro expected to be the next addition to the F70 lineup, as it was spotted in the GSMA database a few months ago and recently popped up on Geekbench with its key specs. While Samsung hasn't announced the Galaxy F70 Pro's launch date yet, we know it's coming soon as Indian online retailer Flipkart has started teasing the phone on its website. Flipkart also gave us a glimpse of the Galaxy F70 Pro's design. It sports a vertically aligned camera island on the rear, featuring three circles - one each for the primary and ultrawide...

title: Fairphone 6+ emerges in listing with surprising amount of RAM
description: The Fairphone 6 launched back in June of last year, and we’ve yet to see any signs of its successor. Being that we’re in the midst of a global memory chip crisis certainly hasn’t helped the Dutch-based sustainable brand, but a new report suggests we may see a Fairphone 6+ soon. The device was spotted in a listing by the folks over at NieuweMobiel and, interestingly enough, the 6+ will feature more RAM than the current Fairphone 6. We can see three listings for the Fairphone 6+ with the models all reportedly featuring 12GB RAM and 256GB storage. As a reminder, the regular Fairphone 6...

title: Samsung reveals the Galaxy Tab S12 series' launch timeframe
description: We've been hearing about the Galaxy Tab S12 series for the past few months, and Samsung has confirmed that it's coming this year without getting specific. This confirmation came from Samsung executive Daniel Araujo during the company's Q3 earnings call while replying to a question about the financial difficulties faced by Samsung's mobile unit during the RAM crisis. Araujo said, “To manage this (financial difficulty), we’re focused on maintaining strong sales momentum of the S26 series, while ensuring the successful launch of new premium products coming out in the second half, such as the...

title: Huawei nova 16 SE to launch next week alongside new MatePad Pro and MateBook Fold
description: Huawei has scheduled a product launch event for August 5, where it will unveil the nova 16 SE alongside newer versions of the MateBook Fold Ultimate Design and MatePad Pro. The company will also introduce a new MateBook Pro S and a lineup of RGB MiniLED TVs. The nova 16 SE is confirmed to be powered by the Kirin 8020 chipset and feature a 6.84-inch AMOLED display with up to 8,000 nits of peak brightness. It will also feature a 50MP primary rear camera with Red Maple Imaging technology and pack an 8,500mAh battery with support for 66W wired fast charging. The handset will run...

title: Oppo A7 Pro Max launch date, color options revealed
description: After recently confirming the arrival of the Oppo A7 Pro Max with a massive 10,000mAh battery, the company has now revealed the smartphone's launch date along with a few additional details. The Oppo A7 Pro Max will be unveiled in China on August 4 and is already available for pre-order through the company's official online store. Oppo has also confirmed that the phone will come with a dual-rear camera setup with a 50MP primary rear camera. And for selfies, the phone will feature a 50MP camera. title: Google's new Pixel 11 Pro teaser offers a better look at the Pixel Glow feature
description: Ahead of its Made by Google event on August 12, Google has released a new teaser for the upcoming Pixel 11 series, and this one offers a closer look at the new Pixel Glow feature. The new teaser highlights how people already rely on several Google services, including Gmail, Google Maps, Search, and Docs, suggesting that switching to a Google-made Pixel phone would be a logical choice. More importantly, the video offers a clearer look at the Pixel Glow RGB LED circle positioned on the rear camera bar of the Pixel 11 Pro. title: Honor X6e arrives with a 7,500 mAh battery
description: Honor has just added a new device to the increasingly crowded X6 lineup, which already includes the X6 itself, the X6a, X6b, X6b 4G, X6c, X6d. Let's now meet the Honor X6e, which has been officially launched in Malaysia. It comes with a 6.61-inch LCD screen with 720x1604 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, and 1,010-nit peak brightness, the MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra SoC at the helm, 4GB of RAM, 128GB of storage, a 50MP main camera with f/1.8 aperture, a 5MP selfie camera with f/2.2 aperture, and a 7,500 mAh battery with support for 45W fast charging. title: This is what the Samsung Galaxy Buds On look like
description: Samsung is rumored to be working on a pair of Galaxy Buds with a new clip-on form factor (new for Samsung, that is - this has been done a lot by most of its competitors recently). We once heard they'd be called Galaxy Buds Able, but in the meantime the name Galaxy Buds On has also been circulated, with "Able" alleged to be their codename. We're going to call them Galaxy Buds On for now, and today a new leak shows us what they look like, thanks to some illustrations that are said to originate from an unnamed Samsung app. Samsung Galaxy Buds On illustrations As you can see,...

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE will be more expensive than its predecessor, here's by how much
description: A few hours ago the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE was certified with support for 45W wired charging just like its predecessor, and now there's a leak telling us how much it will cost in Europe - specifically in France. The base version with 128GB of storage will allegedly go for €799, the model with 256GB of storage will be priced at €899, and the top-end variation with 512GB of storage will cost €1,099. title: Counterpoint: Global smartphone chipset shipments down 15% in first half of 2026
description: Smartphone shipments have been on the decline for the past few months as the ongoing memory chip shortage continues to plague OEMs. And as you can imagine, other components are getting hit too. Take smartphone chipsets, for example. According to the latest Counterpoint Research report, global smartphone chipset shipments have declined by 15% during the first half of 2026. The two biggest players – Qualcomm and MediaTek have been hit the worst, with an estimated 25% decline in SoC shipments compared to H1 2025. title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 review
AT&T is about to have more and faster 5G
description: AT&T has now announced that it has finalized its acquisition of $23 billion worth of spectrum licenses from EchoStar. The transaction was announced back in August of last year. AT&T paid all that money for an average of approximately 50MHz of low-band and mid-band spectrum that covers "virtually every market across the US", more than 400 in total. There's 30MHz of 3.45GHz mid-band spectrum in there as well as 20MHz of 600MHz low-band spectrum. The move will significantly boost AT&T's 5G capacity and download speeds while also helping the company "deliver an AI-ready connected...

title: Google Pixel Watch 5 pops up in an official Google app ahead of expected launch
description: Google will unveil the Pixel 11 series smartphones on August 12, and the company is expected to introduce the Pixel Watch 5 alongside them. We haven't heard anything about the Pixel Watch 5 from Google yet, but the smartwatch has popped up in an official Google app, which should serve as another indicator that Google will unveil it on August 12. The Pixel Watch 5 has appeared in the Google Health app as one of the wearables a user can connect the device to. description: Earlier this month, a rogue OpenAI agent escaped its locked-down testing environment and hacked into Hugging Face, prompting backlash across the tech industry. But there's more to the story. Apparently, the rogue AI stopped by cloud computing company Modal Labs before it got to Hugging Face. And there's more still; apparently, the rogue AI then accessed Modal through one of its customers' exploits, and then used Modal Labs as a stepping stone to carry out its attacks on Hugging Face.
